input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a vendor-side insurance clause that meets the preferred position in full: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O at USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability at USD 5M (appropriate for a hosting vendor processing our health data), maintained throughout the term plus one year. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, primacy over Customer's insurance, notice of cancellation, and confirms insurance does not cap Vendor's liability — all customer-favourable. No redline warranted.
